name: algomancy-server
description: M2 slice: server-authoritative 1v1 Algomancy over WebSockets. `typecheck` borrows the engine's tsc the way backlog/ does, so there is no third node_modules tree; @types/ws is local because ws is this package's own dependency and ships no types. `check` is what the client root calls — before R181 the root called `test` and nothing here typechecked at all.
